app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $70 non-refundable application fee for most degree programs; some colleges charge more.
app_fee.quote: $70.00 for international applicants to most degree programs

fee_waiver.value: The only automatic fee waivers listed are for US armed forces members and veterans, so Indian applicants get none.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are automatically applied for applicants who: | are currently serving in the US armed forces, or

gre_general.value: The graduate school does not set GRE rules; each program does.

toefl_min.value: The graduate school's TOEFL minimum is 80 iBT (or 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: minimum score of 4.5 (on the 1-6 scale) or 80 iBT (on the 0-120 scale)

ielts_min.value: The graduate school's IELTS Academic minimum is an overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: minimum score of 6.5 overall band

english_waiver.value: India is not on the automatic-exemption country list, but a degree from an entirely English-instructing institution waives the test if the university documents English as its medium of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Received or will receive a bachelor's or higher degree from an entirely English-instructing institution. | Please provide documentation stating that the entire university uses English as the medium of instruction.

notes: Graduate College rules. Engineering (CEAS) charges $80 to international applicants and gives no fee waivers; the College of Medicine and the Physics Department set their own English and GRE rules in the program records.
